title: Portable Hold
description: A tiny little dimension to bring along on your Small Ships voyages.
body:
# Portable Hold

Portable Hold is an addon for Small Ships that allows you to travel to a personal pocket dimension from your ship by interacting with it while holding a Portable Hold item. Each player gets their own persistent pocket dimension which resembles the interior of a wooden ship. To return to your ship, simply exit through the portal at the stern of the hold dimension.

Currently there is no configuration.
